Order under Section 4 (1)
WHEREAS an industrial dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner General of Labourwhich accompanies this order exists between,
Mr. Chamil Priyantha Samaradheera, No. 13/2, Batawala, Padukka of the one part
and
Vocational Training Authority of Sri Lanka, 4th Floor, ‘‘Nipunatha Piyasa’’, No. 354/2, Elvitigala Mawatha,Narahenpita, Colombo 05of the other part

NOW THEREFORE I, Ravindra Samaraweera, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powersvested in me by Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 RevisedEdition), as amended by Acts, Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes-Special Provisions) Act,No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint Miss. H. M. Anulawathi, No. 599, Gohagoda Road, Katugastota to be the arbitrator and refer theaforesaid dispute to her for settlement by arbitration.
RAVINDRA SAMARAWEERA,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
Colombo,06th June, 2019.

Mr. Chamil Priyantha Samaradheera, No. 13/2, Batawala, Padukka. of the one part
and
Vocational Training Authority of Sri Lanka, 4th Floor, ‘‘Nipunatha Piyasa’’, No. 354/2, Elvitigala Mawatha,Narahenpita, Colombo 05.of the other part
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether Mr. Chamil Priyantha Samaradheera working as the Senior Programmes Officer of the Vocational Training Authorityof Sri Lanka had been caused injustice by not being given the post of Training Manager and not being placed in the relevantsalary scale in accordance with the appointment letter dated 18.06.2012 and if so, to what reliefs he is entitled.
A. WIMALAWEERA,Commissioner General of Labour.
Dated at the office of the Commissioner General of Labour,Colombo, this 28th day of May, 2019.

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Revocation of Order under Section 4 (1)

WHEREAS by Order made under Section 4 (1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments ofCeylon (Revised Edition 1956) as amended by Acts, No. 14 and 62 of 1957, 14 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 read with IndustrialDisputes (Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968 dated 28.12.2017 and published in the Gazette of the Democratic SocialistRepublic of Sri Lanka Extraordinary No. 2052/22 dated 04.01.2018 the Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specified in thestatement of the Commissioner of Labour dated 19.12.2017.
Mr. J. K. De Silva, No. 8-5/4, Golf Wing, Trilliam Residencies, No. 153, Elvitigala Mawatha, Colombo 08.
and
Ethihad Airways, 03rd Floor, East Tower, World Trade Centre, Colombo 01.
was referred to Mrs. S. Kariyawasam for settlement by arbitration.

AND whereas it is now deemed expedient that the said Order be revoked, I, Ravindra Samaraweera, Minister of Labour andTrade Union Relations do hereby revoke the said Order and further make Order that no proceedings be taken upon the saidOrder dated 09.02.2016.
RAVINDRA SAMARAWEERA,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
Colombo,06th June, 2019.06 - 907/1
